youtube_short.title: Job Loyalty Is Costing You $147,000
title_alternatives: The Salary Trap Loyal Employees Never See Coming
Why Job-Hoppers Out-Earn You by $147K Over 10 Years
youtube_short.description:
You stayed loyal and got a 3% raise. The new hire walked in making 18% more — same job, different budget. People who switch jobs every 2-3 years earn 10-20% more per move, and over a decade that gap hits $147,000. Companies literally run two salary budgets: one to keep you quiet, and a bigger one to poach strangers. Your comfort is someone else's profit. #finance #money #salary #careeradvice #jobhopping #personalfinance

Follow for more money truths nobody in the office will tell you.
